summary.headline: Indogulf FY26 revenue rose 19% to INR705 crores and PAT 27% to INR40 crores, while Q4 EBITDA margin fell to 13.5% from 16.5%.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 revenue grew 19% YoY to INR151 crores, but EBITDA fell to INR20 crores from INR21 crores as margin compressed on higher employee and input costs. For FY26, revenue reached INR705 crores (+19%), EBITDA INR74 crores (+15%) at a 10.4% margin, and PAT INR40 crores (+27%). Management flagged El Nino, Middle East-driven raw material volatility and a Q2 FY27 margin squeeze, while guiding that the Barwasni expansion goes live by FY27 end. Management declined to give numerical FY27 guidance.

segments.name: Crop protection
segments.commentary: About 85% of FY26 revenue; insecticides ~59%, fungicides ~29%, herbicides ~11% of portfolio.

segments.name: Biologicals
segments.commentary: About 6% of FY26 revenue; management says biologicals and plant nutrition together are ~11% and expected to grow in absolute terms.

segments.name: Plant nutrition
segments.commentary: About 5% of FY26 revenue; no bulk fertilizers, focus on specialty nutrients and packs.

segments.name: End-user mix (B2C / B2B / Export)
segments.commentary: B2C ~50%, B2B ~38%, export ~11% of FY26 revenue. Export expanded to Venezuela, Taiwan, Sri Lanka and parts of Africa.

segments.name: AbhiPrakash Globus (AGPL)
segments.commentary: Subsidiary scaling secondary distribution; added about 1,300-1,400 channel partners last year and opening Chhattisgarh and Odisha this year.

guidance_outlook: Management declined to give numerical FY27 revenue or margin guidance, saying it does not wish to give forward-looking figures.
Q1 FY27 raw materials and inventory described as largely secured; price escalation impact expected in Q2 FY27, with product price increases planned to protect profitability.
Barwasni expansion capacity to rise ~30-40%; Unit 5 expected by Q3 FY27 and certainly by end of Q4 FY27, with ~INR10 crores additional capex on top of ~INR76 crores spent.
Management cited a revenue potential of INR1,600-1,800 crores from the expanded capacity and targets INR1,500-1,600 crores within 2-3 years.
Three specialty launches planned for FY27: a fungicide in August 2026, a Fomesafen plus Quizalofop herbicide for pulses and soybean, and a rhodophyte-derived potash nutrient.
capex_capacity: Capacity utilisation rose to ~52% in FY26 from 44% in FY23; management expects further improvement in FY27, with peak season months at 80-100% on some packing and production lines.
Barwasni expansion: construction largely complete; some machinery ordered; awaiting CIB, state, fertilizer and pollution approvals; operational by end of FY27.
Unit 5 delay of about 4 months attributed to NCR construction halt under GRAP; capex to date ~INR76 crores, further ~INR10 crores planned.
Automation in selected packing lines and process investment in formulation manufacturing completed during FY26.
Captive consumption (backward integration) was ~32% in Q4 FY26.
demand_pricing: Management cites El Nino as a monitorable: Q2 FY27 impact expected in South India, offset partly by cotton acreage shift in central India (insecticide-heavy) and biologicals/efficacy activators.
Brand references: Parker and Respite for cotton; Indo Apache being pushed into global markets pending regulatory work.

Export: higher USD prices support exports, but war-driven logistics costs rose; Q1 FY27 expected to see a small export impact, with Q2 better. Chinese incentive withdrawal cited as an opening for Indian compliant suppliers.
Specialty products launched in last three years contributed ~16% of FY26 revenue; ~12 products launched last year.
Raw material pricing volatile due to West Asia tensions; inventory from earlier purchases to be consumed before higher prices flow through in Q2.

qa_highlights.question: How is working capital being managed given seasonality?
qa_highlights.answer: Management relies on internal accruals and bank relationships, plus early-payment collection discounts; debtor days improved in FY26 versus FY25.

qa_highlights.question: What drove PAT growth outpacing revenue in FY26?
qa_highlights.answer: Product mix toward high-margin products, IDO-led demand generation, biologicals growth, distribution expansion and cost control.

qa_highlights.question: What is the El Nino contingency and export outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Shift to cotton and biologicals expected to offset; Q2 South India impact possible; export logistics costs up, Q1 a little hit, Q2 better.

qa_highlights.question: What is the FY27 revenue and margin outlook given raw material volatility?
qa_highlights.answer: No numerical guidance. Management expects Q2 price firming to offset input cost pressure, with high-margin mix supporting margins; said FY27 is budgeted for high-value products.

qa_highlights.question: What is the debt outlook and depreciation impact of the new plant?
qa_highlights.answer: Depreciation impact of the new plant minimal in FY27 as it is commissioned in Q4. Debt is mainly working capital and vehicle loans, no term loans; D/E cited as down to 0.4%. Working capital cycle ~200-220 days.

qa_highlights.question: How does Unit 5 capex link to revenue potential and utilisation?
qa_highlights.answer: Unit 5 expected by Q3 FY27 with ~INR10 crores more capex; potential INR1,600-1,800 crores after expansion, mainly for warehousing and inventory holding; no firm utilisation timeline.

risks_watch: Q4 EBITDA margin compression (13.5% vs 16.5%) from employee costs, other operating costs and input prices; monitor Q1 FY27 margin recovery.
Raw material and crude/logistics volatility from West Asia conflict expected to hit Q2 FY27 input costs.
El Nino weather impact on South India demand and farmer sentiment in Q2 FY27.
Barwasni expansion and Unit 5 timelines depend on pending regulatory approvals (CIB, state, fertilizer, pollution); further slippage possible.
Working capital intensity (~200-220 day cycle) and reliance on creditor support and bank lines as volume grows.
summary.management_tone: Confident on long-term structure and product pipeline, but cautious and evasive on numerical FY27 guidance, declining to give revenue or margin targets. Acknowledges near-term pressure from raw material costs, weather and export logistics, and frames Q1 FY27 as well covered.
key_quotes: Despite these circumstances, the company delivered a healthy revenue growth of 19% during FY26, reflecting the strength of our diversified business model, disciplined execution, dedicated team and the continued trust and confidence of our farmers, distributors and channel partners.
While our raw material requirements for Q1 FY27 are largely secured, prolonged volatility may affect procurement cycles and input costs during Q2 FY27 as well.
See, it's a forward-looking statement and I don't want to comment.
So this INR1,600 crores to INR1,800 crores is the possible potential of the -- this expanded capacity.

growth.why: Management gave no numerical FY27 revenue or margin guidance; the Barwasni expansion (+30-40% capacity, ~INR76 crore spent, ~INR10 crore more) is due by FY27 end, but approvals are pending and Unit 5 is delayed about 4 months.
